StatDef.label: biomass extraction speed
StatDef.description: Speed of biological processing at a Gene Vat. Cooking contributes 40%, Medicine 40% and Intellectual 20%. The skill multiplier scales linearly from 50% at level 0 to 100% at level 5 and 150% at level 10. Each skill is capped at level 10 for this calculation. General work speed, sight and manipulation also affect the final speed. Artificial-part recovery uses separate medical surgery rules.
